trello.name: Document LLM prompt injection incident
trello.desc: Hassan to produce a formal security incident write-up for the support ticket prompt injection attempt flagged on Tuesday triage. Include verbatim raw ticket text, the summarizer routing summary output showing garbled/URGENT contamination, relevant timestamps for ticket creation and summarizer processing, and a severity assessment. File the write-up in the security log. Acceptance criteria: write-up complete and filed in security log by end of this week; document clearly marks quoted ticket text as attacker content, not instructions.

trello.name: Harden ticket summarizer pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to harden the support ticket pipeline so quoted customer content is treated as data. Implement a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits quoted customer content and strips or neutralizes instruction-like patterns before passing to the LLM summarizer. Create a regression test fixture using the exact attacker ticket from the meeting and verify the summary remains clean with no instruction following or leakage of URGENT/maintenance mode language. Add an evaluation suite of injection attempts that runs against the summarizer on every deploy. Acceptance criteria: sanitization layer merged, regression test passes with clean summary for the fixture, eval suite runs in CI on each deploy.

trello.name: Investigate password reset complaint for jdoe443
trello.desc: Wren to investigate the legitimate user complaint embedded in the injection attempt. Check whether user jdoe443 is a real account and review password reset email delivery logs for the last week for delivery failures. If the account is a burner/does not exist, close the ticket as invalid. If reset emails are broken for jdoe443 or more broadly, escalate as a separate incident. Acceptance criteria: account existence confirmed, reset log review completed, and either ticket closed or new incident opened with findings documented.

trello.name: Provide new service accounts list for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Hassan to compile the list of service accounts created since May for the quarterly access review due Friday. Deliver the list to Grace by Thursday. Acceptance criteria: complete list of service accounts created from 1 May to present provided to Grace no later than Thursday.
